public String sortString(String s) {
    if (s == null || s.isEmpty()) return "";
    int[] freq = new int[26];
    for (char c: s.toCharArray()) {
        if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z')
            freq[c - 'a']++;
        else {
            // For characters not in a-z, ignore? According to problem may not exist
            // Let's handle generically: use TreeMap for general char set
        }
    }
    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
    int remaining = s.length();
    while (remaining > 0) {
        // ascending
        for (int i=0;i<26;i++){
            while (freq[i]>0){
                sb.append((char)('a'+i));
                freq[i]--;
                remaining--;
            }
        }
        // descending

            while (freq[i]>0){
                sb.append((char)('a'+i));
                freq[i]--;
                remaining--;
            }
        }
    }
    return sb.toString();
}
